correctness.rationale: Independent coordinate rotations reduce each pair to z_j+ν_j z_j^-1 where ν_j=a_j b_j. Exact fourth-power multinomial Fourier expansion, followed by Parseval, has only zero-sum phase-exponent types e_i-e_j, 2e_i-2e_j, 2e_i-e_j-e_k and e_i+e_j-e_k-e_l. The coefficients of these types (1152d²-2592d+1632,36,144,576) combine into C_d+A_d|S|²+36|2S²-T|², with A_d=96(12d²-33d+26)>0, C_d=2d(192d³-864d²+1604d-1155). Thus min C_d iff S=T=0; d-th roots give witnesses for every d≥4. Positive phase coefficients give max attained exactly for all equal ν_j. For d=4,5, Newton identities and unit-root conjugacy force all minimizing ν_j to rotated regular d-gons. Binary T=d cannot cancel; ternary S=T=0 iff 3|d; quaternary iff 4|d; for d4,5 q-th-root coefficient alphabets attain iff d|q, with q^(d+1)(d-1)! ordered arrays. Sampling orders N_j≥9 avoid collisions among P^4 spatial frequencies. Independently computed exact moment by grouping P^4 Fourier coefficients for selected d=4,5 vectors: 30376 at (1,-1,1,-1), 29800 at (1,-1,i,-i), and aligned maximum 190120 for d4 and 551950 for d5; matched the closed formula. The all-d proof relies on the complete exponent-type enumeration rather than checking d≤5.
